data.title: MN-CCORE Biweekly: CLIF Manuscript Updates & GDMS Survey Launch

data.title: MN-CCORE Biweekly: P1 Gender Disparities & Quality Metrics

data.notes: Kendall McEachron presented literature review on gender differences in mechanical ventilation. Beret Fitzgerald shared early results from her cardiac arrest project. Team agreed on IBW recalculation approach for P1 after reviewing Amato et al. methodology.
